result.question: What does Abimelech do after capturing the city?

readings.answer: He demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
readings.support: Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
captured it and killed its people

assessments.reason: Cites “Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt,” which is explicitly after the capture, but it omits the also-keyed action of killing the people.
“Captured it and killed its people” supports that he killed the people as part of/after taking the city, but it leaves out the destruction of the city that the key includes.
